CHECK (.agents/checks/check_r3m.py, S67–S71, python3 stdlib, comment-stripped, check_r3j style):
- Ran it: all 5 S FAIL on today's code, exit 1 (required). Verified each FAIL reason is a genuinely absent artefact (VisitVitals.kt, prepare `today:`, 3 DraftError values, 5 strings, BpAlertLabel), not a malformed rule.
- S69 logic simulated both ways: post-fix tree → no hits; classic `bloodPressure.split("/")` → hit. Real main tree has zero split/Regex-near-bloodPressure occurrences, so S69 passes as soon as VisitVitals.kt exists. String literals in quotes are ignored so `split("bloodPressure")`-style noise cannot false-positive.

UNIT VisitVitalsTest (Q84, exact spec edges): BP shapes "120/80", "120 / 80", "120 / 80 mmHg", "120/80mmHg", "MMHG", trims; rejects null/blank/"abc"/"12080"/"120/80/90"/"120/"/"/80"/"120.5/80"/"120/80.5"/trailing extra words. Weight: "68", "68.5", "68,5", "70kg", "70 KG", "75.0 kg", "70.5Kg", "68 kilogram(s)" both cases; rejects null/blank/"68.55"/"68,55"/"68,5 kg"/garbage. Plausibility edges 60/30/260/160 inclusive, inverted and systolic==diastolic false; weight 30.0/250.0 inclusive, 29.9/250.1/5.0 false. bpLevel: 139/89 N, 140/80 R, 120/90 R, 159/109 R, 160/80 S, 120/110 S, 120/80 N; null/blank/"abc"/"12080" → NORMAL.

UNIT SaveVisitValidationTest (Q85, AncStateTest-style draft via StartVisit + DraftChanged, fixed today=2026-10-31): future date rejected; today and past dates accepted; "12080"/"BP high" → BLOOD_PRESSURE_INVALID; "300/80"/"80/200" → BLOOD_PRESSURE_INVALID; "5"/"68.55"/"abc" → WEIGHT_INVALID; blank/whitespace BP+weight accepted (no errors); DATE_IN_FUTURE+BLOOD_PRESSURE_INVALID+WEIGHT_INVALID all come back together (and nothing else); valid values stored exactly as typed-and-trimmed (" 120/80 " → "120/80", " 68,5 " → "68,5", whitespace date → same ISO, per spec "stored command text unchanged").

MANIFEST: STATIC-r3m, UNIT-visit-vitals, UNIT-save-visit-validation added (tier 1, cmds as spec format; deps cover every file named in S67–S71 incl. VisitVitals.kt, SaveVisitCommand.kt, AncState.kt, VisitEditor.kt, ClinicalBadges.kt, WorkspaceScreen.kt, ProfileScreen.kt, strings.xml, DemoFixtures.kt; covers Q84/Q85/S67–S71).

- app/src/test/.../state/AncStateTest.kt lines 155, 182, 520 call SaveVisitCommand.prepare(state, op, newVisitId) with 3 args — still compile via the default `today`; draft dates there (2026-10-08/15) are in the past so no future-date regression.
- DraftError usages: AncStateTest only (INVALID_DATE, STALE_REVISION) — enum extension is additive, no exhaustive construction.
- No older test saves a visit with a future date; older test BP/weight values ("118/76", "120/80", "130/85", nulls) all valid/blank — unaffected. No "BP high"-style free-text saves in existing tests.
- Older checks: only check_r3l.py mentions SaveVisitCommand.kt (S65 isSyntheticEdit) — unaffected.
